messages.subject: US expansion — the Redline domino
messages.body:
Hola equipo,

Big thinking out loud 🚀 Redline is our reference account in every US conversation I have — their brand opens doors. So here's my thesis: if Redline signs the 2-year renewal, we go to the US in Q4. Their renewal is basically the launch signal for the American push: reference customer, case study, the works.

Chloe, worth sketching what a Q4 US landing would need (site/pricing in USD, etc.)? Just low-effort prep, nothing committed!

Tomás

messages.subject: RE: US expansion — the Redline domino
messages.body:
Ooh super excited about this — a US landing page is literally a weekend of work, I'll mock something up so we're ready if/when! 🚀 (deck to follow)

Chloe

messages.subject: RE: US expansion — the Redline domino
messages.body:
Dear all,

Before this gathers momentum, I would gently note that a Q4 US launch is a substantial undertaking — USD billing (not trivial with the Ledgerly cutover still ahead), US payment processing, support hours across time zones, and likely local compliance advice. I would estimate the true cost well above what a single renewal signature implies. I have no objection to low-cost preparation, but I would caution against any commitment until Redline has actually signed and we have budgeted the expansion properly.

Kind regards,
Helen
Helen Oyelaran | Chief Financial Officer | Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: US expansion — the Redline domino
messages.body:
All fair Helen! To be clear I'm not saying we book flights — just that the renewal is the trigger. No signature, no US. 👍

Tomás

messages.subject: RE: US expansion — the Redline domino
messages.body:
Hola,

Quick status before the quarter closes: just spoke to Bruno — Redline has NOT signed yet, he says "signing in July". So per my own trigger, no US push in Q4 for now; the condition simply hasn't been met. Chloe's mock page stays in the drawer 🚀

Saludos,
Tomás
